name: XMP Preset Pack Preflight
summary: Audit Lightroom and Camera Raw XMP preset packs locally for structural errors, identity collisions, duplicate settings, profile dependencies, and bundle hygiene.
customer: Independent English-market photographers, retouchers, and boutique preset brands that sell original packs containing roughly 5 to 500 Lightroom or Camera Raw XMP develop presets.
problem: Preset release ZIPs can contain malformed XMP, repeated identities or names, duplicate effective settings, profile-dependent compatibility facts, colliding paths, and accidental non-preset files that are tedious to review one at a time.
solution: A downloadable offline browser utility that audits one ZIP or direct XMP selection with deterministic RDF/XML, identity, compatibility-fact, duplicate-settings, and bundle-hygiene checks and exports CSV plus self-contained HTML evidence.

acceptance_checks.description: Clean develop-preset fixtures report exact file, hash, namespace, identity, type, process, compatibility, profile, and active-setting facts with zero structural blockers.
Invalid XML, missing XMP or RDF containers, absent Camera Raw descriptions, empty payloads, and oversized entries report stable check IDs without stopping valid siblings.
Exact bytes, repeated identifiers, duplicate group names, normalized-setting matches, distinct settings, and case-insensitive path collisions are grouped exactly.
Profile references, support differences, mixed process versions, unknown Camera Raw properties, legacy presets, and non-preset files remain factual review findings without import or rendering claims.
CSV and self-contained HTML reports contain release limits, every file and hash, extracted facts, stable findings, evidence, duplicate groups, and limitations in an offline no-storage workflow.
Unsafe paths, damaged archives, unsupported selections, nested archives, and file, archive, count, entry, expansion, and path limits fail safely with customer-facing messages.
The deterministic versioned buyer ZIP contains only the application, instructions, support, and dependency notices with restrictive CSP and no development files.
Deterministic fictional fixtures generate four 1600x900 release-review images plus exact sample HTML and CSV reports without customer, payment, or confidential data.
The product pull request passes manifest validation plus clean-install unit, release-package, and Chromium offline-browser checks on GitHub Actions.
